consequence.statement: Existing ExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. Before a later release removes v1beta1, a storage version migration (rewriting all objects) and an update of status.storedVersions must be run.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all ExternalSecret objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions of the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1, so existing ExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. A storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
